thirdPartyGameContentPosture.what: The application is a production calculator for the game Factorio. Its datasets under src/data/** describe recipes, items, and machines for Factorio and for community mods (Bob's/Angel's, Krastorio 2, Pyanodons, Space Exploration, Bio Industries, Factorio Extended Plus), and each dataset directory ships an icons.png sprite sheet of game artwork.
thirdPartyGameContentPosture.storage: These files are Git LFS objects at the pinned revision; the git tree stores pointer stubs and the payloads live in LFS. See lfs.json.
thirdPartyGameContentPosture.position: Factorio game data and artwork belong to their respective rights holders and to the mod authors. They are carried only as part of the acquired upstream source and are not relicensed, rebranded, or reused as Versionless assets. The upstream MIT grant covers the repository's own files; it is not treated here as a grant over third-party game artwork.
thirdPartyGameContentPosture.unknownPreserved: Whether the upstream project holds permission to redistribute Factorio artwork, and on what terms, is neither established nor disclaimed by this record.
